rows.where: Door balloon fallback 1 of 5. {item} = loot name

rows.text: Put the {item} down before I make you.
rows.where: Door balloon fallback 2 of 5. {item} = loot name

rows.text: You nicked the {item}. I noticed. Bad day for you.
rows.where: Door balloon fallback 3 of 5. {item} = loot name

rows.text: Cute fingers. The {item} still has my name on it.
rows.where: Door balloon fallback 4 of 5. {item} = loot name

rows.text: Keep the {item} warm. I'm taking it off you warm.
rows.where: Door balloon fallback 5 of 5. {item} = loot name

rows.text: My knife?! Spit it out!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You steal a blade and smile? I'm smiling next.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 2 of 5

rows.text: That knife leaves with me. Fingers optional.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 3 of 5

rows.text: One knife. Two claimants. Do the math, pest.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Don't throw it. I want it back unbent.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking throwing_knife · line 5 of 5

rows.text: That's MY shield, you little raccoon!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Hide behind it. I'll wait. I've waited worse.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Stolen wood won't save sticky fingers.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Nice grab. Terrible future.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Keep it up. Makes the pry job easier.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking shield · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Those prongs are mine!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You grabbed my Sai. Now we dance ugly.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Pokey thief. Pokey ending.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Put them down. I asked nice once.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Fancy steal. Still mine.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sai · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My luck charm — on YOU?!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Shiny thief. Short career.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 2 of 5

rows.text: That medallion hums for me. You're noise.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Hand it over. I'll be almost polite.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Jewelry on a pest. Classic last mistake.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking medallion · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My helmet! Wrong head!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Cover up. I'll aim anyway.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You swiped my lid. Bold. Dumb.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 3 of 5

rows.text: That metal's mine. Your thoughts can stay.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Wear it. I'll take the rest separately.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking helmet · line 5 of 5

rows.text: MY BOOT — give it!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You stole a boot. I stole a seat. Guess who wins.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 2 of 5

rows.text: That's my size. Your foot's a suggestion.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Boot thief. I'm laughing. Then I'm not.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Keep it laced. I reclaim clean.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking da_boot · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My book! Close it!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Homework's over, thief. Fight's on.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Magic pages. Sticky paws. Bad combo — for you.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Don't crease it. I'll still fold you.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 4 of 5

rows.text: That grimoire called me. You just grabbed.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking grimoire · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Those gloves were already my color!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You put them on. I put on teeth.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Red looks busy on you. It'll look better elsewhere.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Sticky red fingers. Adorable. Temporary.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Gauntlets: mine. Blood: negotiable.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bloody_gauntlets · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My plate — on a pest?!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 1 of 5

rows.text: I'll dent it. Then I'll keep it.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Tin thief. Ribs can commute.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Armor stolen. Teeth not.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Polish it. I collect shiny trophies.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking breastplate · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Wrist jewelry. Mine.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bracers · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Snap them off after I win.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bracers · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You grabbed bracers. I grabbed a chair.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bracers · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Cute armor. Wrong monster now.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bracers · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Leave them on. Better portrait when I reclaim.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking bracers · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My smoke?! Hiding already?
rows.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Puff. Me. You — briefly.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You stole my exit. Cute. Cancelled.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 3 of 5

rows.text: I live in the dark. Your trick's a candle.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Take the bomb. I'll find the smell.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking smoke_bomb · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My brass — on YOUR fists?!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 1 of 5

rows.text: You want to punch me with my knuckles. Precious.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Those are mine. Your plan is napkin math.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Packed for a brawl with stolen gear. Rude.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Keep them warm. Reclaiming a pair.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking knucklers · line 5 of 5

rows.text: Fake teeth. Cute. I have the real set.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking fangs · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Teeth thief at a teeth fight. Brave. Stupid.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking fangs · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Those fangs are extras. I want them back.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking fangs · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Bite toys. Guess the target.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking fangs · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Hold them ready. Matching pair incoming.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking fangs · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My green vintage — spit it!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Poison thief. You first.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Don't spill. I want every drop home.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 3 of 5

rows.text: You packed my flask. I packed appetite.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Keep the symptoms. Return the bottle.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking poison_flask · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My flail! Spikes AND theft? Respect. Briefly.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 1 of 5

rows.text: That goes back on my wall. You go on the floor.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Finally a thief with taste. Still a thief.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 3 of 5

rows.text: You picked the mean one. I noticed.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Don't name it. I already did.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking spiked_flail · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My juice? Planning to live with MY juice?
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Second chance stolen. I'm reclaiming it full.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Red flask. Red ending. Brand consistent.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Don't sip. I want it sealed.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Sweet steal. I'll take it off the quiet body.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking healing_potion · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My crossbow! Point it elsewhere, then give it!
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Bolt thief. Bow stays. Holes optional.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You aimed MY bow in MY room. Rude.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Don't scratch the stock. Reclaiming soon.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Range on a pest. I brought more range.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking crossbow · line 5 of 5

rows.text: MY hammer! Overkill theft. I approve the overkill.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Big tool. Small thief. Short story.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 2 of 5

rows.text: You dragged my sledge into my nest. Fun. Fatal.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 3 of 5

rows.text: Wall can keep the hole. Hammer comes home.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 4 of 5

rows.text: I'll take it. Keep the headache.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking sledgehammer · line 5 of 5

rows.text: My watch! Time's up — not poetry.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 1 of 5

rows.text: Tick. That's me walking. Tock. That's you not.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 2 of 5

rows.text: Nice steal. Time of death: pending.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 3 of 5

rows.text: You grabbed a clock. I grabbed a seat.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 4 of 5

rows.text: Stop winding. I'll stop you.
rows.where: Door balloon after taking pocketwatch · line 5 of 5

Rain worked the loft window above the tannery in {village}. A small goblin lived there alone.
Then a knock cut through the wet night.
Delivery for the grandchild of {bartleby} {snatchwick}. Sign here. Or bite here. I hear you're a biter.
Your grandfather, {lucky_snatchwick}, has died inside {the_grumble}.
He left you everything. Unfortunately, everything is still under the mountain.
Up {hill}, in {the_grumble|poss} shadow, {nib} walks you home.
Here we are, {hero}. Wipe your feet. He never did.
Skip
Click to continue
The Last Will & Considerable Testament of {bartleby} {snatchwick}, Esq.
I, {grandpa_full}, being of sound mind and even sounder luck, do hereby leave EVERYTHING to my grandchild, whom I met only once. You bit me. Good instincts.
Everything is presently inside {mountain}, in the pockets of assorted monsters who picked it up after I fell over. Each piece is engraved with my name. They know it is not theirs.
Bring my things home and set them in the {cabinet}. Only what you are holding when you get out counts. What the mountain keeps, it keeps.
When the Cabinet is full, this cabin and the deed to {hill} are yours. {nib} will stamp it. {nib} loves stamping.
{nib} is to be paid in biscuits. Do not open the left-hand drawer of my desk.
B. {snatchwick}, Esq.

rows.text: Welcome home, {hero}. Well. His home. Yours on paper, once the cabinet's full.
Everything with his name on it went into the mountain with him. The monsters have been wearing it ever since.
Bring it back, put it on his shelves, and the deed's yours. I'll stamp it. I love stamping.
Whoa, whoa. Straight into {the_grumble}? Without a word from the professional?
rows.where: Run door clicked before the tutorial is done

rows.text: First delve's on me. I'll walk you through it. What do you say?
Show me how
I'll wing it
Just like him. Off you go. Try to come back with more than you left with.
There. Practically a professional. Now go and fetch his things.
rows.where: After the tutorial finishes, back in the cabin

rows.text: He used to sit in that chair and flip a coin for hours. Never lost a toss. Never explained it.
The map's wrong, by the way. He drew it from memory. His memory was mostly confidence.
If the radio stops, tap the glass. Gently. {gloria} bites.
Every piece is engraved: 'Property of B. {snatchwick}. If found, how dare you.'
He tied rope ladders in every belly of the mountain. 'For emergencies.' He used them for lunch.
I'm not sentimental. I'm an executor. Executors don't cry. They file.
That's him, the year he lost a duel to a hatstand. He'd want me to say 'won'.
Keep it lit. He said the cabin gets lonely.
His chair. Rocks on its own sometimes. Draughts. Definitely draughts.
rows.where: Click the hero in the chair

rows.text: A quarter of his shelves! He'd have thrown a party. Then knocked something over at it.
rows.where: Homecoming that crosses 25% of the cabinet

rows.text: Halfway, {hero}. The cabin's starting to smell like him again. That's a compliment. Mostly.
rows.where: Homecoming that crosses 50% of the cabinet

rows.text: Three quarters. I've started drafting the deed. In pencil. I'm not made of ink.
rows.where: Homecoming that crosses 75% of the cabinet

rows.text: Empty? Well. You came back. That's the part he never managed.
The mountain keeps what it catches. You'll catch it back.
Sit. Warm up. The Grumble isn't going anywhere. It's a mountain.
Look at that! Home where it belongs!
Shelves, {hero}. Shelves!
He'd be insufferable about this. In a good way.
That one's new! Off to the hall with it.

rows.text: Close the journal. Open the door. The mountain owes you a rematch.
The cabin will wait. It always does. It has excellent manners.
I died famous for luck. You will live famous for trying. Better deal.
Bones mend. Pride mends slower. Both mend if you keep moving.
When in doubt, take the shiny thing and apologize to history.
Leave the mountain something to miss. Preferably not your hat.
Failure is a footnote. Footnotes are where the truth hides. Congratulations.
The engraving says how dare you. Wear that energy into the next room.
Stand where the light is thin and your luck is thick.
Hunger is a strategy. So is soup. I endorse soup.
If you see a shortcut, assume it sees you first.
Bank early. Brag later. Bragging early is how I met the floor.
The Spin does not care about your feelings. Charm it anyway.
Write the bruise down. Future you will call it foreshadowing.
A quiet bell helps. A quieter ego helps more. I mastered neither.
Keep your heels pointed homeward even when your head is pointed elsewhere.
Monsters improve you. You improve the furniture. Fair trade.
One more delve. Always one more. That is the whole religion.
Dust yourself off with dignity, or with a rag. I prefer the rag. It's honest.
The will said everything. It did not say "easily." Fine print of the heart.
Soft moss is a trap. Hard stone is honesty. Prefer honesty, briefly.
Never apologize to a boulder. It will take it personally and roll.
If the lantern goes out, you still have spite. Spite is a renewable resource.
A trophy unbanked is a story unfinished. Finish loudly next time.
Tips from the deceased: stay curious, stay greedy, stay vaguely upright.
I met every brick in this place personally. Some of them remember fondly.
Whisper a vow, then shout a Spin. Order matters.
Your pockets are finite. Your next attempt is not.
The belly of the mountain has no manners. Reply in kind, then leave.
Falling with style still counts as falling. Falling with notes counts as science.
Do not open the left-hand drawer. That advice has outlived me. Heed it.
Home is where the Cabinet is. The Cabinet is where the proof is.
Counting to four is plenty. Beyond that is showing off.
Hold the Block for the thing that laughs. Everything else is practice.
If you can still limp, you can still learn. Limping is underrated scholarship.
A good plan survives contact. A great plan apologizes and revises.
The mountain keeps what you drop. So don't drop your nerve.
Bring biscuits for {nib}. Bring stubbornness for yourself. Priorities.
Defeat is temporary. Embarrassment is archival. File yours under "research."
Never trust a corridor that smiles. Corridors should not have opinions.
When the wheel goes quiet, listen for your own breathing. Then ignore it and try again.
Luck prefers the prepared. I preferred lunch. We compromised.
Sleep on it. The bruise will still be there; you'll just be ruder to it.
A monster that beats you once has taught you its name. Charge interest later.
Always map the exit before the entrance. I never did. Look how wise I sound.
Pack light regrets. They bruise less than heavy ones.
Courage is continuing after you've already explained yourself to the floor.
If at first you don't succeed, invent a reason you meant to fall.
Get back up. The mountain is terrible at keeping score.
A setback is just a setback with better lighting.
B.S.

Hey friends — thanks for playtesting my game, {game_title}.
Just a few notes before you jump in.

First. This game is in early prototype mode. The things I most want to hear from your feedback are about what is fun, what is boring, what is confusing, and what things you think I should add to the game.
Second. Be honest and picky! You don't need to consider anyone else's perspective. I just want to hear yours.
And finally, have fun! Break the game, find cool combos, test the limits. And don't be afraid to dream big with your requests.
This is the menu you'll land on.
**Brand New** starts from the beginning, as if you had never played.
**Middle Progress** puts you a few dungeons in, with some items already unlocked.
**Continue** picks up your last playtest save.
**Feedback** opens a note to me. Use it for anything that is not tied to one card.
You can right-click any item or monster in the game and leave feedback. That is useful for bugs, confusion, or balance issues.
For general comments while you play, click **Feedback** in the bottom right, or press **F2**.
This is the F2 screen. Type a note, click Send, and it goes to my game development console. Next time I sit down to work, I will see it and can make the fix or the change.
However — for those who want to give the best kind of feedback, I would love to actually HEAR your experience.

Consider taking your phone, setting it to a voice memo or recorder, and just letting it run while you play. Talk out loud about your thought process, your first impressions, your feedback, anything at all.

Then send me the entire file when you are done, because I can turn that into a much more detailed look at your player experience. If you are interested in doing that, you can email the files to me at nathan.elequin@gmail.com.
So thank you again for playtesting. If you have any questions, you can always reach out to me. Now enjoy!

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · unused fallback · Verdant Hollow
rows.text: I stepped into the Verdant Hollow and at once felt the wet through the soles of my boots. Moss covered the walls and much of the floor, and the air smelled of earth after rain. I raised my lantern and went on along the only path that offered itself, deeper under the mountain.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · unused fallback · Crystal Cavern
rows.text: I entered the Crystal Cavern and had to blink against the glare. Pillars and sheets of ice lined the passage and threw my lantern light about in hard flashes. My boots rang on the frost; the echo died quickly in the cold air. I went forward with short steps, watching where I set my feet.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · unused fallback · Ashen Crypt
rows.text: I came into the Ashen Crypt with dust already on my tongue. The halls were dry and quiet, and along the walls stood open niches that held nothing but the crumbled remains of old offerings. I walked on at a steady pace and listened, but I heard only my own breathing and the soft scrape of my boots.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · unused fallback · Cinder Forge
rows.text: Before I saw the Cinder Forge I felt the heat on my face. The stone underfoot was warm, and farther in I heard metal strike and saw sparks drop to the floor. I wiped my brow and kept walking. {grandpa} had come this way before me; I meant to do the same, and to come out again.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · unused fallback · Shadow Abyss
rows.text: The path turned down into the Shadow Abyss, and my lantern lit only a few feet of stone ahead. Beyond that circle I could see nothing at all. I put my left hand on the wall and went down one step at a time, careful of my footing, for a fall here would end the dig in a hurry.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Verdant Hollow · page 1
rows.text: I left the cabin path and ducked into the Verdant Hollow. Wet moss slicked the stone under my boots, and cold water wicked in at the seams.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Verdant Hollow · page 2
rows.text: The air smelled of mud and crushed leaves.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Verdant Hollow · page 3

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Crystal Cavern · page 2
rows.text: A few paces later the mud stiffened and cracked in the cold — Crystal Cavern. Ice burned my palm when I touched the wall. My breath showed white.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Crystal Cavern · page 3
rows.text: I stamped the dirt off my boots and stepped out onto the frost.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Ashen Crypt · page 1

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Ashen Crypt · page 2
rows.text: The melt dried to grit almost at once, and the air went still and dusty: Ashen Crypt. Fine ash stuck to my damp socks and tasted bitter when I breathed through my mouth.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Ashen Crypt · page 3
rows.text: I pulled my collar up and kept to the middle of the hall.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Cinder Forge · page 1

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Cinder Forge · page 2
rows.text: The stone under my palm went from cool to warm to hot, and then I was at the Cinder Forge. Sweat prickled at my hairline. Sparks popped and died near the floor.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Cinder Forge · page 3
rows.text: I rolled my sleeves and walked into the heat.

rows.where: Biome-enter splash · narration · Shadow Abyss · page 2

Only 3 enemies left now. Let's Spin and continue - this is gonna be easy!
Oops. Yeah, I may have lied a little.
These Harpies hit you the second you Spin onto them.
And again after every item you use while Facing them.
Hmm - if we want to defeat these Harpies while minimizing damage, we need to think carefully about when we Spin and how we sequence our items.
Okay, she's got 5 HP. If we use any item that doesn't kill her, she will attack again.

desk_notes.highlight: (don't highlight spiked flail until next line)

rows.text: Your Flail could one-shot her. But let's save that for now.
Let's use Arrow Head instead. This will do the trick.
Perfect. We Lost 2 HP from using Arrow Head, but at least she didn't Attack us again.
Uh oh. I made a huge mistake.

desk_notes.highlight: no highlights, show the whole board

rows.text: The instant you Defeat an enemy, it will trigger the next Spin.
...if that wheel Spins onto the other Harpy, she will kill you before you get a chance to react.
Oh no, here comes the Spin...I can't look!

desk_notes.say: Nib comes closer and speaks more directly to the player

rows.text: Whew! That was a close one! Okay, next time I promise I'll account for that possibility. That's my fault.
So we COULD kill this Dragon right now using your Spiked Flail. But if we do, we'll Spin onto the other Harpy and die.

Look at these arrows here - these allow you to [color=#6a3c00][b]Move 3[/b][/color] times per dungeon, left or right. They do NOT count as a [color=#6a3c00][b]Spin[/b][/color]. Let's try [color=#6a3c00][b]Moving[/b][/color] onto the Harpy and see what happens.
Great, it worked! Her ability did not activate. That's the power of Movement.
Now you're down to [color=#6a3c00][b]2 Moves[/b][/color] remaining - more than enough to finish this dungeon.
By my math, this Shield is enough to Defend against her Attacks. Let's use it.
Perfect. Now end it.
Finally - those Harpies are dangerous.
Now let's finish this.

desk_notes.highlight: Now the wheel should close out the Harpy. should auto-spin as soon as player clicks 'Next'

rows.text: Monsters with a red background are [b]Deadly[/b], and carry the strongest abilities. This Dragon's Attack completely ignores Block.
But, we saved a surprise tool for later that we can finally use.
Let's slay this dragon. End this.
Every choice can make or break you in these dungeons, so let me give you one last piece of advice:
Plan ahead. Find Item combos and Monster counters. Expect the best Spins...but prepare for the worst.
But for now, let's take you home. Or rather, to the new home you will inherit if you complete your grandfather's will. Come, let's go.
